title: Kartel's Hub - Pack a Rare Farm
features:
🟣 Pack A Rare Farm Features:
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
Farm Features:

• Auto Open:	Drives the game's own autoOpen() in a loop — waits out the reel, handles gold reveals, auto-selects a pack if none is selected, hops back to the Packs page if you're elsewhere, and stops on errors/limits

• Fast animations	Flips the game's FastModeButton attribute so reels run at full speed
• Stop on gold	Halts when the reel offers "Spin for Gold" (default on)

• Stop at rarity	Dropdown — stops the run once a pull is that rarity or better

• Pack limit	0 = endless, otherwise stops after N packs

• Open one pack / Reset session counter	Manual open + counter reset
Live labels	current status, packs opened this session
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

💠 Collection Features: 


• Auto sell duplicates	Writes the real auto-sell settings the game's own 

• AutoSellUI reads (nested sell[tier] shape) and arms it — verified live

• Sell everything up to tier	Slider 0–8, follows the game's live tier list
Keep copies of each card	1–5 copies of each tier are never sold

• Also sell error cards	Sells error (E) variants too

• Auto claim vault / Claim vault now	Manual claim verified (592K → 667K)

• Auto claim index rewards / Claim index now Claims all ready set rewards

• Safety	Gold cards are never sold; medals/vouchers never sold
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

🎯 Grading Features: 

• Auto grade ungraded cards	Navigates to Grading, clicks each Pick_* tile's Face button to select, submits, skips reveals, idles politely when the queue is 
full or Auto Open holds the screen

• Grade once	Single select-and-submit cycle (verified end-to-end)

• Submit current selection	Fires the game's SubmitButton on whatever you picked

• Live label	queue state + free grades remaining
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

⚗️ Boosts Features: 

• Potion to use dropdown (All, Vault Earnings, Grading Odds, Gold Chance, Mutation Luck, Error Card Luck, God) + Use potions now — only activates potions you own that aren't already running

• Claim all quest rewards — clicks every Claim button on the Quests page

• Navigate: one-click jumps to Packs, Battles, Grading, Mutation, Rebirth, Index, Quests, Shop

• Live label: potions running

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

📊 Info Features:
• Refresh stats now, Show overlay HUD toggle

• Live labels: coins, collection count/value, space left, vault unclaimed, grading queue, rebirths, error card chance
